labels.org.opencontainers.image.title: Rustdesk

dockerfile.amd64:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-selkies:debiantrixie

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG RUSTDESK_VERSION
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="thelamer"

# title
ENV TITLE="RustDesk" \
    NO_GAMEPAD=true \
    NO_FULL=true \
    PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=true

RUN \
  echo "**** add icon ****" && \
  curl -o \
    /usr/share/selkies/www/icon.png \
    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/linuxserver/docker-templates/master/linuxserver.io/img/rustdesk-logo.png && \
  echo "**** install packages ****" && \
  apt-get update && \
  if [ -z ${RUSTDESK_VERSION+x} ]; then \
    RUSTDESK_VERSION=$(curl -sX GET "https://api.github.com/repos/rustdesk/rustdesk/releases/latest" \
      | jq -r '.tag_name'); \
  fi && \
  curl -o \
    /tmp/rustdesk.deb -L \
    "https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/releases/download/${RUSTDESK_VERSION}/rustdesk-${RUSTDESK_VERSION}-$(uname -m).deb" && \
  apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    /tmp/rustdesk.deb && \
  apt-get install -y xdg-user-dirs && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  apt-get autoclean && \
  rm -rf \
    /root/.cache \
    /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    /var/tmp/* \
    /tmp/*

# add local files
COPY /root /

# ports and volumes
EXPOSE 3001

VOLUME /config

# Changelog
 <details>
 <summary>Changelog</summary>

# Added

- [Keyboard shortcuts #14933](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/14933)
- [feat(update): verify signed update metadata #15914](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/15914)
- [feat(address-book): add a toolbar button to open the web console #16680](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16680)
- [Add trusted-device V2 with legacy upgrade compatibility #16548](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16548)
- [feat(android): transfer files directly through SAF folders #16644](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16644)

# Changes

- [Remove ConfigUpdate handling 9f9585ce](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/commit/9f9585ce155a6558f0625eaf8fabfe8827c9a552)
- [change(video): improve clarity after scrolling by re-encoding static frames #16128](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16128)
- [Tune MediaCodec static refresh budgets #16579](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16579)

# Fixes

- [fix(drm): size a plane-rotated scanout as the mode transposed #16444](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16444)
- [fix(drm): the startup cache warm does not wake sleeping displays #16437](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16437)
- [fix(drm): drop a frame equal to the previous one, as the other capturers do #16450](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16450)
- [fix(drm): pace the producer to the rate the encoder takes, with the panel refresh as floor #16423](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16423)
- [fix(macos): open Screen Recording settings from Configure #16452](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16452)
- [fix(wayland): avoid clock waits in PipeWire capture #16430](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16430)
- [fix(wayland): place a portal stream at the only output of its size #16451](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16451)
- [Fix/wayland input keyboard layout #16462](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16462)
- [fix(video): defer refresh teardown until hw encoder warms up #16459](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16459)
- [fix: resolve HTTP API 407 errors through HTTPS proxies #16496](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16496)
- [Fix/preserve deleted printer #16500](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16500)
- [fix: a refused privacy-mode request no longer turns off another connection's #16507](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16507)
- [fix(linux): report the process user as the active user under Flatpak #16519](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16519)
- [Fix/macos mouse release #16516](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16516)
- [fix: auto-login types the OS password only at the logon or lock screen #16520](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16520)
- [fix(mobile): prevent late mouse-down after floating button release #16541](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16541)
- [fix(terminal): trim the replay buffer when output has no newline #16545](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16545)
- [fix(wayland): a pending portal request no longer stalls the server #16542](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16542)
- [fix: read host= from an exe path with non-ASCII characters #16556](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16556)
- [fix(windows): move installer scripts into protected temp directories #16554](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16554)
- [Fix fdroid bridge version #16560](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16560)
- [fix(linux): stop using the window in onWindowClose once GTK destroyed it #16561](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16561)
- [fix(client): report one error when both WebRTC race legs fail #16563](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16563)
- [fix(x11): keep the RandR monitors reply alive while iterating it #16595](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16595)
- [Forward audio latency environment to Linux user server #16597](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16597)
- [fix: bracket a bare IPv6 ID server when deriving the API server #16624](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16624)
- [fix: warn about insecure custom API server connections #16616](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16616)
- [Fix/download path validation #16601](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16601)
- [fix(file-transfer): keyboard navigation in the desktop file list #16642](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16642)
- [fix(ffmpeg): handle QSV encoder stalls and undersized buffers #16303](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16303)
- [fix(windows): protect installer handoff and use native service control #16562](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16562)
- [fix(linux): match the xrandr output name at the start of its line #16590](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16590)
- [fix(linux): gtk sudo shows no false "Sorry, try again." and retries with sudo-rs #16652](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16652)
- [fix(android): wheel scrolling from the controller does not reach Android peers #16409](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16409)
- [fix(ios): keep background music playing during remote sessions #16660](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16660)
- [fix(client): invalidate auto FPS state when updating FPS limits #16283](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16283)
- [fix(linux): load peers when the app dir is unset #16698](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16698)
- [fix(windows): name the privacy window executable explicitly #16711](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16711)
- [fix(web): preserve peer card clicks with semantics enabled #16709](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16709)

</details>
